svg.text: MATL: Al 1100-H14 or 6063-T5. Skived, folded or bonded fin.
Base flatness 0.03. Ra 0.8 max on the TIM face.
VC-202 SHALL be anodised, 5 um clear minimum. Radiation carries 28% of the
VC-201 finish is free - forced convection swamps radiation.
Fit ONE configuration only - alternates, not stackable.
Relief pocket clears the folded pinch-off tube, 0.5 min after pinch.
PASSIVE CAPACITY - VC-202, Tj 85 C MAX, NO FAN, FINS VERTICAL
WHY THE FINISH IS SPECIFIED - Tj 85 C, 25 C AMBIENT
Pitch optimum 4.8 mm (17.0 W); 5.0 mm used as a round tooling pitch.
Passive floor with channels fully blocked: 4.6 W from envelope radiation alone.
SELECTION TABLE - Tj 85 C ROWS AT 25 C AMBIENT
Al 1100-H14 / SKIVED OR BONDED / 68 x 68 x 22
